value.text: The saved process declares an agent-proposed mapping from Places.PublishPending to Forecasts.consume on weather.place-requested; it does not establish broker routing or runtime delivery. At source, the listener parses and validates the record before entering a transaction. A parse or validation exception enters the rejection branch: an INVALID_EVENT row is written and the record is acknowledged; if the rejection write fails, the acknowledgement is not reached. A valid event inserts its id into inbox. An existing id returns before the place upsert and refresh call; a new id upserts the place and calls refresh(place) inside the callback. The listener acknowledges after the transaction call returns, so an exception exiting that call prevents this source-level acknowledgement. The accepted Consume weather.place-requested service operation retains the detailed handler body; this page locates it in the declared Places-to-Forecasts path. Saved refresh and publisher views are links, not proof of order or atomicity. Runtime routing, delivery, and transaction outcomes remain unverified.
